scientific.integrity: Exact angle-ordering proof covers every integer n>=5 and every point of every side; symbolic expansions and 401880 independent vertex-distance comparisons provide additional verification, not an infinite certificate. Three directly relevant full primary works have been compared, including their main results and conjectural limits. Same-model scientific review passed; independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The theorem evaluates regular polygons only, not global minimizers among all polygons of the same vertex number.
The n=3 triangle and n=4 square radius values are previously known and used only as consistency checks.
A separate even-polygon diameter-bisection result has the same scalar numerical expression; the even radius value is not claimed independently as novel.
An unindexed equivalent family profile remains a possible historical originality risk.

title: Complete farthest-distance profiles and sharp self-Chebyshev stability for regular polygons
